clips.title: The story
paras: The Cenarion Circle gathers in Darnassus beneath Fandral Staghelm’s leadership of the night elven druids. The Cenarion Enclave is their central gathering place and seat of power in the capital, among its great hollows and living boughs.

High above the Temple Gardens, the Cenarion Enclave gathers the Cenarion Circle beneath ancient oaks and ashes marked with runic bark. Its halls take shape from living wood and stone. With Malfurion Stormrage absent in the Emerald Dream, Archdruid Fandral Staghelm oversees affairs here and presses his ambitious vision for Teldrassil despite political friction with High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. Druids meditate by the streams, while the capital’s elven hunters gather here too. At the stables, skilled riders learn to tame Darnassian nightsabers.

The Cenarion Enclave is known as a tranquil sanctuary, yet quiet business takes place beneath its westernmost bough. A refuge lies under the hollowed roots, where Darnassus’s clandestine rogues work shielded by the canopy above.
